title: First look and association checkpoint

blocks.what_we_do: Summarise the valid tests and save the key association outputs for recovery.
blocks.why: A list of small p-values is not yet an interpretation. Record the model, cohort, test counts and fitting status before plotting. The next module explains multiple testing, correlated peaks and confounding comparisons. Never call a simulated lead a clinical finding or assume the nearest gene is causal.
blocks.you_need: Association output from 6.4 and reviewed table from 6.5.
blocks.command:
```{r s6-7}
results <- guided_association(guided_path(cfg, "6.4", "association"))
summary <- data.frame(samples = 1811, retained_variants = 238513, finite_tests = sum(valid_p(results$P)),
  genome_wide = sum(results$P[valid_p(results$P)] < 5e-8),
  lambda_autosomes = lambda_gc(results$P[results$CHROM %in% as.character(1:22)]))
guided_write(summary, guided_path(cfg, "6.7", "summary.tsv"))
print(summary)
files <- c(paste0(guided_path(cfg, "6.4", "association"), ".Disease.glm.logistic.hybrid"),
  guided_path(cfg, "6.3", "covariates.tsv"), guided_path(cfg, "6.5", "top20.tsv"), guided_path(cfg, "6.7", "summary.tsv"))
guided_artifact_checkpoint(cfg, "6.7", files)
check_step("6.7", data_dir = cfg$out, work_dir = cfg$out)
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

Not applicable: no PLINK operation is needed for this R-only or laboratory step. The R chunk is the complete command; PLINK cannot perform a laboratory measurement.

R reads or calculates the displayed values without changing the genotype files.
blocks.expected_result:
1,811 retained samples, 238,513 retained variants, 236,815 finite tests, eight genome-wide significant variants and autosomal lambda approximately 1.016. Key analysis files receive a SHA-256 artifact manifest.

The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks passed on Windows; main test counts and significance match the instructor reference.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the named input and the previous step. Keep the command and console logs; do not substitute files from a different dataset version. See [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.quick_check:
Do eight significant variants necessarily represent eight independent association signals?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

No. Nearby variants can share a signal through LD; clumping at 7.5 groups correlated associations.

</details>
